name: Centaur

dims.source: Dealer measurement verified in data/spec_sheets_staging.json (Reverb 90989796: 6 5/8 x 5 x 2 in, secondary, knob inclusion unstated); W/D adopted from it (6.63 x 5.00), bare H 1.98 resolved from calibrated back photo (references/klon-centaur_measurements.md). Conflicts flagged there: heights.json footprint 6.50 x 5.03 corroborates, its 1.87 in height is an enclosure inference (rejected); Warm Audio Centavo clone 6.75 x 5.00 x 2.25 corroborates footprint, its 2.25 is knob-inclusive overall (not bare).

enclosure.notes: Single gentle slope measured from back/front/hero views (see references/klon-centaur_measurements.md): bare back 1.98 in to bare front 1.70 in over 5.00 in depth. Gold cast box; stepped perimeter flange in the photos is a constant-width simplification (profile extrudes uniform width).

knobs.note: Photo-derived blob centroid on klon-centaur_top.jpg, symmetrised (see measurements). Oxblood tapered knob ~1.08 in dia; closest parts.js knob is mxr Davies (black) scaled dia 1.22 / height 0.85.
Photo-derived centre knob, same row as GAIN/OUTPUT.

led.note: Red LED left of the GAIN label, forward of the knob row (top view red-mask centroid; corroborated in hero/detail-gain).

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp front-right of the centaur graphic (top-view highlight centroid, provisional; corroborated in hero/detail-output).

jacks.note: IN on the back wall, pedal right (+x) — image-left viewed from behind (back view).
OUT on the back wall, centre-left in pedal coords (back view).

powerJack.note: 9V round barrel on the back wall left of OUT (back view, image-far-right = pedal left).

notes: Klon Centaur original gold (horsey) hero. Custom cast enclosure as a single gentle profile slope (1.98 back / 1.70 front); all deck parts seat via surfaceAt() — no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. Audio jacks + 9V on the back wall (face:'back'). Top print (GAIN/TREBLE/OUTPUT serif, centaur line graphic, CENTAUR-TM) is in textures/klon-centaur-decal.png (serif + line art vector labels cannot reproduce). Back-wall IN/OUT/9V print is inventoried in the measurements file but omitted from labels[]: parts.js already positions face:'back' labels correctly, but validate.html expectedPos() has no face-back label case (anchors get deck-height/NaN expectations), so any back label fails check A — shared-validator fix listed in the build report. Knob positions are photo-derived blob centroids (measurements file); footswitch and jack heights are provisional single-view values as flagged there. Knob colour: library mxr knob is black; the real oxblood tapered knob needs a reusable parts.js builder (listed in the build report, not edited here).
